summary: The install playbook must first include ansible.mcp_builder.common with public: true, then your role, then fix ownership of common_mcp_base_path for common_runtime_user; the built-in install_mcp playbook only handles ansible.mcp_builder roles.
questions: Why must ansible.mcp_builder.common use public: true?
Can I use ansible.mcp_builder.install_mcp with my own role?
How do I write the install playbook for a custom MCP role?
